turns.sql:
WITH street_circuits AS (
  SELECT circuitId FROM circuits
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%street%'
),
races_decade AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, (r.year / 10) * 10 AS decade
  FROM races r
  JOIN street_circuits sc ON r.circuitId = sc.circuitId
)
SELECT
  rd.decade,
  AVG(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed,
  MIN(pit.milliseconds) AS fastest_pit_stop_ms
FROM races_decade rd
JOIN results res ON rd.raceId = res.raceId
LEFT JOIN pitStops pit ON rd.raceId = pit.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL AND res.fastestLapSpeed <> ''
  AND pit.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rd.decade
ORDER BY rd.decade;

turns.sql:
WITH street_circuits AS (
  SELECT circuitId
  FROM circuits
  WHERE 
    name LIKE '%Street Circuit%' OR
    location LIKE '%Monaco%' OR
    location LIKE '%Singapore%' OR
    location LIKE '%Baku%' OR
    location LIKE '%Melbourne%' OR
    location LIKE '%Jeddah%' OR
    location LIKE '%Miami%' OR
    location LIKE '%Las Vegas%' OR
    name LIKE '%Monaco%' OR
    name LIKE '%Singapore%' OR
    name LIKE '%Baku%' OR
    name LIKE '%Melbourne%' OR
    name LIKE '%Jeddah%' OR
    name LIKE '%Miami%' OR
    name LIKE '%Las Vegas%'
),
races_street AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year
  FROM races r
  JOIN street_circuits sc ON r.circuitId = sc.circuitId
),
race_stats AS (
  SELECT
    rs.raceId,
    rs.year,
    MAX(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS max_fastest_lap_speed,
    MIN(pit.milliseconds) AS fastest_pit_stop_ms
  FROM races_street rs
  LEFT JOIN results res ON res.raceId = rs.raceId
  LEFT JOIN pitStops pit ON pit.raceId = rs.raceId
  GROUP BY rs.raceId, rs.year
),
decade_avg AS (
  SELECT (year / 10) * 10 AS decade,
         AVG(max_fastest_lap_speed) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed
  FROM race_stats
  GROUP BY (year / 10) * 10
)
SELECT
  da.decade,
  da.avg_fastest_lap_speed,
  rs.raceId,
  rs.fastest_pit_stop_ms
FROM race_stats rs
JOIN decade_avg da ON (rs.year / 10) * 10 = da.decade
ORDER BY da.decade, rs.raceId;

turns.sql:
SELECT c.name AS circuit_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Accident' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accident_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Collision' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS collision_count,
       COUNT(*) AS total_incidents
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN status s ON res.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE s.status IN ('Accident', 'Collision')
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
ORDER BY total_incidents DESC;
